title: Read a changelog and find the breaking change (B1)
summary: Đọc một changelog dài nhiều phiên bản, tìm thay đổi gây lỗi khi nâng cấp và viết ghi chú nâng cấp cho đội.
learningObjectives: Đọc lướt changelog theo phiên bản
Tìm thay đổi gây lỗi và cách sửa
Viết ghi chú nâng cấp ngắn bằng tiếng Anh

parts.heading: Version 3.0.0 (released 2026-02-10)
parts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. This is a major release. BREAKING: the submit handler now receives one object with the form values instead of separate arguments. Code that wrote onSubmit(name, email) must change to onSubmit(values) and read values.name and values.email. BREAKING: Node 16 is no longer supported; use Node 18 or newer. Added: the validate option can now run asynchronous checks, such as checking whether a username is already taken. Changed: error messages are now strings, not objects. A codemod is available to update most call sites automatically: run npx formkit-migrate and review the changes before you commit.

parts.heading: Version 2.8.0 (released 2026-01-12)
parts.content: Added: the disabled option for single fields, so that a field can be turned off without removing it. Added: the reset method now accepts new initial values. Deprecated: the onSubmit(name, email) style with separate arguments. It still works in 2.x but prints a warning in the console and will be removed in version 3. Fixed: the form no longer loses focus after a failed validation when the page uses a custom scroll container. Performance: large forms with more than two hundred fields render about thirty percent faster.

parts.heading: Version 2.7.1 (released 2025-12-05)
parts.content: Fixed: a crash when a field was removed while its validation was still running. Fixed: the touched state was not reset when reset was called twice in a row. Fixed: an error in the TypeScript type definition of the validate option, which accepted only synchronous functions. Documentation: added an example for multi-step forms and corrected the description of the dirty state. No API changes in this release, so it is safe to install without code changes.

parts.heading: Version 2.7.0 (released 2025-11-18)
parts.content: Added: support for field arrays, for example a list of phone numbers that the user can extend. Added: the useFieldValue hook, which lets a component read the value of one field without re-rendering the whole form. Changed: the default debounce for validation on typing is now two hundred milliseconds instead of one hundred. If your tests expect the old timing, update the waiting time or set debounce explicitly. Fixed: radio buttons inside field arrays did not keep their selected value.

parts.heading: Upgrade notes
parts.content: To upgrade from 2.x to 3.0.0, first move to version 2.8.0 and remove every warning about the deprecated submit style. Then update Node, install 3.0.0 and run the codemod. Search your code for onSubmit with several arguments and for code that reads error.message, because errors are now plain strings. After the upgrade, run your form tests and check the asynchronous validation. Teams that cannot upgrade Node yet should stay on 2.8.x, which receives security fixes until the end of the year.

It still receives name and email, in a new order
correctAnswer: It receives one object with the values
exercise.explanation: Phiên bản 3.0.0 đổi tham số của onSubmit.

exercise.question: Is 2.7.1 safe to install without code changes?
options: Yes, it has no API changes
No, it requires Node 18 or newer
correctAnswer: Yes, it has no API changes

exercise.question: What changed about the default debounce in 2.7.0?
options: It was removed, so you must set it yourself

exercise.explanation: Phần Upgrade notes nêu các bước.

vocabulary.definition: thay đổi gây lỗi khi nâng cấp
vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Thay đổi làm code cũ không còn chạy đúng.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Nói a breaking change, không nói a broken change.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Còn dùng được nhưng sẽ bị xóa trong tương lai.
vocabulary.example: The old submit style is deprecated.

vocabulary.definition: công cụ tự sửa code hàng loạt
vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Chương trình tự cập nhật code theo quy tắc.
vocabulary.example: Run the codemod to update call sites.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Viết codemod thành một từ, không viết "code mod".

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Cập nhật code hoặc dữ liệu để chạy trên phiên bản mới.
vocabulary.example: We will migrate to version 3 next month.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Nói migrate to, không nói migrate in.

vocabulary.definition: có thể cài mà không sửa code
vocabulary.commonMistake: Nói "safe to install" hoặc "safe to upgrade"; không nói "safe for install".

expressions.example: Version 3.0.0 introduces a breaking change: the submit handler receives one object.

expressions.phrase: ___ is deprecated and will be removed in ___.
expressions.meaning: Báo tính năng sắp bị bỏ.
expressions.example: The old submit style is deprecated and will be removed in version 3.
alternatives: ___ still works, but you should stop using it.

expressions.meaning: Mô tả các bước nâng cấp.
expressions.example: To upgrade, first move to 2.8.0, then install 3.0.0.

expressions.meaning: Báo bản không cần sửa gì.
expressions.example: No action is needed for version 2.7.1.

exercises.question: What does "deprecated" mean?

It was already removed in the latest version
It is a faster version of an old feature

exercises.explanation: Deprecated là còn dùng được nhưng sẽ bị bỏ.

performanceTask.title: Write upgrade notes for your team
performanceTask.scenario: Bạn đọc changelog của một thư viện và viết ghi chú nâng cấp cho đồng đội.
performanceTask.baselinePrompt: Đọc đoạn changelog ngắn rồi viết ghi chú nâng cấp bằng tiếng Anh (60 đến 120 từ): thay đổi gây lỗi, cách sửa và thứ tự nâng cấp. Chưa xem bài mẫu.
performanceTask.performancePrompt: Write upgrade notes in English, 60 to 120 words: the breaking changes, how to fix them and the order of the upgrade.
performanceTask.modelResponse: Upgrade notes for FormKit 3.0.0. There are two breaking changes. First, the submit handler now receives one object, so onSubmit(name, email) becomes onSubmit(values). Second, Node 16 is no longer supported, so we need Node 18 or newer. Errors are also plain strings now. Plan: move to 2.8.0 first and remove the deprecation warnings, then update Node, install 3.0.0 and run the codemod with npx formkit-migrate. After that, run the form tests. If we cannot update Node yet, we stay on 2.8.x.
performanceTask.retryPrompt: Write the notes again in English. Keep the structure and make the order of the steps clearer.
performanceTask.transferPrompt: Write upgrade notes for a different changelog (a table library), using the same structure.
performanceTask.reviewPrompt: Write upgrade notes for another changelog without looking at old notes.

artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Excerpt. 4.0.0: BREAKING sessions expire after 24 hours by default; set sessionHours for longer sessions. BREAKING the login method returns a user object, not a token; read the user from that object. 3.5.0: the token return is deprecated. Upgrade: move to 3.5.0 first and stop using the token, then install 4.0.0.

rubric.description: Versions and code names match the changelog.

anchors.met: Versions, options and tools are correct.

rubric.description: Uses words such as breaking, deprecated and migrate.
